preconditions.description: The number of blocks in string t must be between 1 and 200,000.
The number of blocks in string s must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l_i <= 1000000 for l_i in t_lengths)
preconditions.description: Each length of the blocks in string t must be between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l_i <= 1000000 for l_i in s_lengths)
preconditions.description: Each length of the blocks in string s must be between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c_i in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c_i in t_chars)
preconditions.description: Each character in string t must be a lowercase English letter.

preconditions.expression: all(c_i in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c_i in s_chars)
preconditions.description: Each character in string s must be a lowercase English letter.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of occurrences of string s in string t.
